package: two pads on the board, bridged with solder – no part
sources: the design itself: Adafruit's Eagle library microbuilder, device SOLDERJUMPER, package SOLDERJUMPER_ARROW_NOPASTE (two SMD pads 1 and 2, no paste – open as the board is made), BOM EXCLUDE, as the schematic 'Adafruit USB C microlipo charger.sch' at commit d8ab4b0 of https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-MicroLipo-PCB carries it

kind switch, roles common and throw_a: open unless a load of sim.json closes it – the board's state as delivered is open (100 mA); 'change it over to 500mA mode by soldering closed the jumper on the front' (Adafruit, product 4410)
r_on_ohm 0.01: a solder bridge across two pads, assumed – no data sheet
notes: Copper on the board, no part to buy; the graph names it with bom false.

verified.datasheet: Adafruit microbuilder Eagle library, package SOLDERJUMPER_ARROW_NOPASTE (in the schematic)
checked: two pads, pad 2 on PROG, pad 1 on R4 (schematic and board file of the same commit)
open: the resistance of a solder bridge is assumed (10 mΩ)
